questions.q: What nickname did the crew use for Long John Silver?
choices: Barbecue
Cap'n Flint
Old Salt
Peg-leg
questions.evidence: Now, Barbecue, tip us a stave

questions.q: Why did the crew's song carry Jim back to the Admiral Benbow?
choices: It was the old captain's song
It was a song his father had taught him as a small boy
The name of the inn was sung in the chorus
His mother used to sing it to him at night
questions.evidence: I seemed to hear the voice of the captain piping in the chorus

questions.q: What problem did Mr. Arrow have on the voyage?
choices: He was often drunk and had no command over the men
He was terribly seasick for the whole of the voyage
He kept getting the ship lost in the fog
He quarrelled loudly with Silver every single day
Where Mr. Arrow got his drink
Who had stolen the captain's chart
Where Silver's parrot had come from
Why the captain disliked the squire
questions.evidence: we could never make out where he got the drink. That was the ship's mystery.

questions.q: What happened to Mr. Arrow one dark night?
choices: He vanished overboard and was never seen again
He was put in irons for being drunk on watch
He was made captain in Smollett's place
He took a boat and rowed away in the dark
questions.evidence: he disappeared entirely and was seen no more

questions.q: Who served in a way as mate after Mr. Arrow was gone?
choices: Job Anderson, the boatswain
Israel Hands, the coxswain
Long John Silver, the ship's cook
Tom Redruth
questions.evidence: The boatswain, Job Anderson, was the likeliest man aboard

questions.q: How did Silver manage to cross the deck in heavy weather?
choices: He used lines rigged across the deck, "Long John's earrings"
Two of the other sailors carried him across between them
He crawled across the deck on his hands and knees
He stayed in the galley and never crossed the deck at all
questions.evidence: Long John's earrings, they were called

questions.q: What did Israel Hands tell Jim about Silver?
choices: He was educated and braver than a lion
He was a coward who was afraid of the sea
He could not read or write a single word
He was a cousin of the squire's
questions.evidence: a lion's nothing alongside of Long John!

questions.q: What did Silver name his parrot?
choices: Cap'n Flint
Pieces of Eight
Billy Bones
Admiral Hawke
questions.evidence: I calls my parrot Cap'n Flint, after the famous buccaneer

questions.q: Silver says, "you can't touch pitch and not be mucked." What does he mean?
choices: Being around bad things makes some of the bad rub off on you
Tar is very hard to scrub off the deck of a ship
You should never let a parrot sit on your shoulder
Sailors must always keep their hands clean at sea
questions.evidence: you can't touch pitch and not be mucked, lad

questions.q: How did the squire feel about Captain Smollett during the voyage?
choices: He despised him
He admired him greatly
He was afraid of him
He felt sorry for him

questions.q: Why did the captain think spoiling the crew with double grog and treats was a bad idea?
choices: He believed it would turn the men into devils
He thought it cost far too much of the squire's money
He wanted to keep the treats for the cabin
He thought rich food would make the men seasick

questions.q: Why did Jim climb into the apple barrel just after sundown?
choices: He wanted an apple
He was hiding from the captain
He had been told to clean it out
He wanted to spy on Silver
questions.evidence: it occurred to me that I should like an apple

questions.q: Why did Jim decide not to show himself after hearing Silver speak?
choices: The lives of the honest men depended on what he heard
He was too sleepy to climb out
He was stuck fast in the bottom of the barrel
He wanted to jump out and surprise Silver
questions.evidence: the lives of all the honest men aboard depended upon me alone
